title: We invite you on a journey into AGI solutions. On blockchain, and beyond
description: We invite you on a journey into the world of AGI solutions built on blockchain technology, and beyond. You bring the idea, Fractera AGI does the rest.

blocks.title: We invite you on a journey into AGI solutions
blocks.description: Not just a site template. It quickly grows into what you need: an agent that solves your tasks, an application, or automation of your business processes. You decide. All you bring is the idea; Fractera AGI does the rest.

blocks.text: It builds the application with you: the Claude Code agent of this element writes the code from your description.
It takes what is ready from the built-in Store: more than 2,000 reliable, continuously updated skills, plugins and MCP servers.
It finds ready solutions in the AGI-web3 infrastructure, so you can buy them and plug them in.
You describe your idea. The agent works through the possible ways, agrees them with you, and you get a reliable result fast.
A built-in database, sign-in with user roles and dozens of other solutions. All of their code is open right inside your application: fix it, improve it or remove it. It is up to you.

landing.claim: From idea to enterprise product, 99% faster
landing.claimHint: You work inside an infrastructure that is already tuned for speed and surrounded by everything a product needs, before you need it: from sign-in and multiple languages to plugging in ready solutions of other developers.
landing.closingTitle: Your idea is the only thing missing
landing.closingText: Sign in, open the terminal and describe what you want. The rest is already here.
landing.short: An agent, an application or business automation. You bring the idea, Fractera AGI builds the rest.

outcomes.name: Agent

outcomes.name: Application

outcomes.name: Automation

board.closing: Your train leaves the moment you describe the idea
